protocol: KONOSUBA_JAPANESE_HUMOR_AND_VOICE_PROTOCOL §5–6; VOLUME_DEEP_READING_METHOD §7.2; applied to admitted expanded artbook with explicit source-plane limitation
selected_set_warning: 68 selected original potential premises include nested/callback/soft visual/commentary units. They are not disjoint source-first census episodes; there is no portability percentage or fitted threshold. Each whole selected premise may have subordinate forms. H1 is only within the identified source plane, never automatic main-world admission.
H_overlay_warning: H2 is amplification caution, not automatic denial of literal magical/material effects. H4 only marks actual nonliteral stylization/metafictional/imagination; main magical toads, salmon and spells remain source-present.
